    beta_orig = beta

    if key in TT:
        entry = TT[key]
        if entry.depth >= depth:
            if entry.flag == 0:
                return entry.value
            elif entry.flag == 1:

            elif entry.flag == 2:
                beta = min(beta, entry.value)
            if alpha >= beta:

    winner = check_winner(flat_board)

        TT[key] = TTEntry(val, depth, 0)
